description: Rhasspy Piper: a fast, fully offline neural text-to-speech engine (VITS-based, ONNX runtime). This fighter runs the US English lessac voice at high quality (Piper's largest single-speaker quality tier: best audio quality, highest latency).
notes: Offline ONNX voice; the plugin resolves the short name 'lessac-high' via the rhasspy/piper-voices catalogue. Quality-tier variant complementing the -low piper fighters (amy-low, ryan-low).
